text:
Type: white flush ceiling lamp
Use: general room lighting close to the ceiling; hallway, bedroom, living room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: white plastic diffuser shade, white mounting plate
Colors: pure white, soft diffused glow
Shape: drum-like shade made of overlapping rounded panels that form a scalloped petal outline, mounted flat against the ceiling, compact and light
Feel: soft, clean, gentle, friendly
Goes with: white ceilings and walls, light wood, pastel tones; Scandinavian or minimalist bedrooms and hallways

product.name: LYSBOJ
product.description: Diffused light that provides good general light in the room.
